core_obligations: State the route through the fibre lemmas and announce that a direct proof follows (proof lines 8192-8195).
One direction: a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions is etale (proof lines 8197-8200).
Converse: each affine open is such a finite disjoint union, all points are closed, the space is discrete (proof lines 8200-8207).
Deduce the statement about fibres of an etale morphism from the first part (statement (2), proof lines 8192-8207).
proof_roadmap: The direct proof, first direction (proof lines 8197-8200).
difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the etale schemes over a field as the disjoint unions of spectra of finite separable field extensions, and deduces that every fibre of an etale morphism is such a disjoint union over the residue field of the point. The proof gives a direct argument from the algebra lemma on etale algebras over a field: in one direction a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions is visibly etale, and conversely each affine open of an etale scheme over the field is a finite disjoint union of such spectra, so all points are closed, the space is discrete, and the structure morphism is the disjoint union of the affine pieces.
